import json,os
base='bench/results/environment-narration/live-check'
for route in ('reported','corrected'):

    assert rows, route+': no rows'
    print(route,'replicates',len(rows),'calls',summary['calls_made'],'stopped',summary['stopped_reason'],'errors',len(summary['errors']))

PY
